The '''''Whisper''''' was an [[IL-5 Ocula]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] built by the [[Czerka Arms/Legends|Czerka Corporation]]. It was later purchased by the [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]], who modified it with a variable transponder code system, basic stealth features, and a secure communications array.<ref name="Codex" />

[[Mandalore the Avenger]] seized the ship after her [[Mandalorian Trat'ade|forces]] discovered it involved in a smuggling operation in [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. Her technicians further improved the ship's stealth systems and scanners.<ref name="Codex" /> The ship was used during the [[Mandalorian civil war (Third Galactic War)|Mandalorian civil war]] to travel to [[Ruhnuk]]<ref name="A Rock and a Hard Place">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|A Rock and a Hard Place|Odessen}}</ref> and also used to [[Malgus's escape|rescue]] [[Darth Malgus]] from [[Carrick Station]].<ref name="Sundering">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=general|Sundering|Carrick Station}}</ref>
